title: Designing Audio Effect Plugins in C++ (Will Pirkle)
summary: Comprehensive DSP textbook for audio plugin development with JUCE examples.
description:
## Overview

Will Pirkle's textbook is a primary reference for DSP algorithm implementation in audio plugins. It covers filter design, dynamics processing, delay effects, and modulation.

## Key Topics

| Chapter | Topic |
|---------|-------|
| 1-3 | Filter theory and implementation |
| 4-6 | Dynamics processing (compressor, limiter, gate) |
| 7-9 | Delay-based effects (echo, chorus, flanger) |
| 10-12 | Modulation and spatial effects |

## Relevant For

- Filter design (SVF, biquad)
- Dynamics processing
- Delay line implementation
- Reverb algorithms

## Citation

Pirkle, Will. *Designing Audio Effect Plugins in C++*. Focal Press, 2018.

## URL

https://www.focalpress.com/books/designing-audio-effect-plugins-in-c/

## Why Important

Authoritative source for DSP algorithm implementation with working code examples.
